Subject: MAP orchestration kickoff — BlueCrest private/VPC deployment (VPN, IAM/KMS owners)

Hi Helen / BlueCrest team —

Thanks again for the productive calls last week. Per our SOW and the evaluation plan we discussed, I wanted to kick off a focused mutual action plan (MAP) to get the private/VPC deployment across the finish line. The core goals here are:

- Validate network connectivity and VPN/peering options
- Confirm IAM/KMS ownership and any key-wrapping/HSM requirements
- Agree on a short evaluation window (staging -> canary -> production) and an approximate close timeline

I've put an initial MAP draft in the Drive folder (link below) that breaks the work into milestones and owners. Please review and confirm the internal BlueCrest owners for networking and key management. From Redwood side I'm proposing the following primary owners:

- Networking / VPN / Peering: Marissa Cole (CSE) — marissa.c@redwood.com
- IAM & KMS integration: Karthik Iyer (Infra Lead) — karthik.i@redwood.com
- Deployment topology / infra orchestration: Vivek Kulkarni (Product Eng) — vivek.k@redwood.com
- Commercial / MAP coordination: Sean Gallagher (me) — sean.g@redwood.com

Proposed 2-week high-level timeline:
1) Week 1: Network pre-checks and KMS policy review
2) Week 2: Staging deployment + smoke tests, decision gate for canary
3) Week 3: Canary + performance verification, finalize cutover window

Can you please:
- Confirm BlueCrest owners for Networking/VPN and Keys (name + email)
- Flag any compliance constraints (e.g., key custody, required HSM/PACS)
- Call out blackout windows or procurement gating items we should track in the MAP
Attachments: MAP-BlueCrest-draft-v1.pdf (map + milestone grid), network-checklist-bluecrest.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_map_folder

If that looks good I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with technical owners (VPN + IAM) for Monday or Tuesday morning PT.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sean —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear owners list. BlueCrest is aligned to move quickly on this evaluation window. Our suggested internal owners are below:

- Networking / VPN / Peering: Tom Donovan (Network Eng) — tdonovan@bluecrest.com
- IAM & KMS: Priya Menon (Security Ops) — pmenon@bluecrest.com
- Compliance / Audit contact: Marcus Lee (InfoSec) — mlee@bluecrest.com

A couple quick notes from our side:
- For KMS, we currently require customer-managed keys in AWS KMS with a key policy that restricts root-level operations. If Redwood requires key wrapping or HSM-backed keys we need to understand the pattern and whether CloudHSM is required.
- VPN term: we prefer IPsec site-to-site peering initially; if you recommend Transit Gateway peering that may add procurement lead time for network changes.

We are available for a kickoff Tue 10 Nov 08:30–10:30 PT or Wed 11 Nov 09:00–11:00 PT. Please pick a slot and send calendar invite with dial-in and an agenda.

Helen Zhao
Senior Program Manager, Technology Delivery
BlueCrest Financial
hzhao@bluecrest.com | +1 (212) 555-4490
